_about: Denis Diderot (1713-1784), philosopher and editor of the Encyclopédie: Early Philosophical Works (Philosophic Thoughts, Letter on the Blind with its Addition, Letter on the Deaf and Dumb), translated and edited by Margaret Jourdain (Chicago and London: Open Court, 1916), raw IA OCR, clean 0.91; The Paradox of Acting, translated with annotations by Walter Herries Pollock, with a preface by Henry Irving (London: Chatto & Windus, 1883), raw IA OCR, clean 0.91. Not taken: Francis Birrell's Dialogues (1927), already on the broadway-library shelf. US public domain. No uids minted.
